name: cleric
description: Careful, low-risk codebase cleanup across seven tracks: deduplication, type consolidation, dead code removal, circular dependency untangling, type strengthening, error-handling cleanup, and removal of deprecated code and AI leftovers. Each track inspects, writes an assessment, and ranks proposed changes by confidence. Only HIGH-confidence, LOW-risk changes are applied automatically, with type checks, tests and lints run after each batch; MEDIUM and LOW changes wait for your approval. Every batch is its own commit, one git revert away. Cleric never merges code that only looks similar, never removes dynamically imported code, never weakens legitimate boundary types, never silences real errors, and never treats comments as a source of truth.
